$Comment: Adds 1080 to the Headless Horseman's maximum health on the hard ride while his hard fight has at least 2 players in it: the hard twin of Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Scale_Health_P2. His hard fight's script applies it as he rises, one step per player up to 5, then refills him (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Scale_TopUp). It stays on him for the whole fight, through his change from the saddle to his feet. Amount is the health one more player adds.
